technical.summary: REGN shows short-term overbought conditions with conflicting intermediate-term signals; extreme RSI9 and stochastic readings suggest limited upside without pullback, making this a poor swing entry despite bullish price structure.

fundamental.summary: REGN shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 72 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (10/10) presents contrarian buy opportunity despite weak congressional selling pressure and absent news confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe VIX crisis regime (384.96) with flat yield curve and negative macro score create highly unfavourable conditions; earnings in 72 days adds moderate event risk.
